source_51.title: National Health Mission Tamil Nadu 51st Executive Committee Agenda, Part A
source_51.notes: Source reports FY2025–26 observed deliveries and the CEmONC beds for all 94 DMS facilities. Bed occupancy rate, staffing proposal, priority, and the publisher's rounded monthly value are excluded. DME medical college hospitals are a separate cohort. Centre and district names retain the report's printed spelling. The 94 site rows sum to the published Table 1 totals of 137,712 deliveries and 6,173 CEmONC beds. The narrative's all-DMS count is a separately published aggregate and is not the source of these targets.

dialysis_capacity_model.description: Sort the other programme sites' March 2024 sessions per reported functional machine and take the observation at rank ceil(0.90 times n), using rank 1 for the smallest value. Multiply by the destination's March 2025 reported functional machines. Training includes all prior sites for a destination without a March 2024 record.
dialysis_capacity_model.interpretation: A historical throughput benchmark for planning. It uses completed sessions as a proxy for served workload. Actual staffed capacity and demand that did not receive service are unknown.

pressure_inputs.basis: historical planning with predicted monthly dialysis throughput
